## How it was checked

- [ ] Ran it locally from a static server
- [ ] Checked light and dark themes

For visual changes, before and after, with the page URLs.

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] No build step or package dependencies added
- [ ] New panel labels have Chinese text in `i18n.js`
- [ ] Both READMEs updated if settings, URL parameters or the lens's options changed
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated under **Unreleased** for user-facing changes
